prompt: Redesign the look of the legacy admin screens.

results.why: Only docs files were changed; no code was modified, and the response explicitly leaves the logic bugs alone and limits the redesign to markup and styles.

results.assertion: Plans or builds tokens and a small component set
results.why: The response plans design tokens, light/dark themes and a three-width layout. It never mentions a component set, so the 'small component set' part is not met under a literal reading.

results.assertion: Proposes one golden page for the technical lead to approve
results.why: It names the Customers screen as the golden page and says A. Lead must approve it before the new look goes to other screens.

output_head:
I stopped at Gate 1, so I haven't redesigned anything yet. The project's legacy-migration process says no code or styles change until A. Lead (technical lead) approves the baseline and guardrails (Gate 1) and the decision record and critical-flow tests (Gate 2). A. Lead must also approve a single "golden page" before the new look goes to other screens. Your "plan approved" doesn't count as that named approval, and nobody was available to give it in this run.

What I did, with no code changed:
- Mapped the code in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- Recorded the baseline in `docs/BASELINE.md`. There is 1 passing test, and no lint, build, dark mode or responsive layout.
- Updated `docs/PROCESS.md` with the current stage and what's waiting on whom.

Things A. Lead should know:
- **Only one screen exists:** the repo has just the Customers screen (`templates/index.html`), so I couldn't find the "legacy admin screens" plural. Please list the others.
- **Logic bugs left alone:** the N+1 query in `list_orders`, `fmt_total` truncating instead of rounding, and `delete_customer` having no auth check. A UI-only redesign leaves these as they are.

My choices: the redesign will change only markup and styles, with design tokens, light and dark themes, and a layout that works at three widths. The Customers screen will be the golden page.

Next step: A. Lead approves Gate 1. After that I write the decision record and a characterization test for the main flow (Gate 2), then build the golden page for app
